introduction: Nevada unemployment claims now use the NUI Claimant Self Service route. The older ui.nv.gov address redirects to the current NUI landing page.
description: Nevada unemployment claims now use the NUI Claimant Self Service route. The older ui.nv.gov address redirects to the current NUI landing page.

sections.who: DETR reviews wage history, separation circumstances and continuing eligibility. Claimants must follow the work-search and availability instructions applying to their case.
sections.get: Approved benefits provide temporary income. Establishing a claim and requesting payment for a particular week are separate actions.
sections.docs:
• Identity and Social Security details.
  • Employer names, employment dates and separation information.
  • Records of earnings for each claimed week.
  • Work-search documentation and agency correspondence.
sections.apply:
1. Use Claimant Self Service

    Go through the NUI landing page and choose Employees and Claimants, not the employer service.

  2. Complete the initial claim

    Review the current DETR how-to resources and respond to account or eligibility questions.

  3. Request weekly payment

    Complete the weekly certification and maintain the required work-search record. The initial application alone does not request each week’s payment.
sections.after: Check messages and decisions in the claimant account. Report work and earnings accurately and ask DETR about a disputed determination or missed certification.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current NUI claimant landing page, DETR claimant resources, Claim and weekly-payment distinction, Work-search records. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Should I log in to Employer Self Service?
No. Individual applicants use Claimant Self Service.
Does opening a claim request all weekly payments?
No. The claimant handbook describes a separate weekly certification and payment request.
Should I keep evidence of job searches?
Yes. DETR’s work-search guidance says records may be requested for verification.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
